name: WiLI-2018
description: This paper describes the WiLI-2018 benchmark dataset for monolingual written natural language identification. WiLI-2018 is a publicly available, free of charge dataset of short text extracts from Wikipedia. It contains 1000 paragraphs of 235 languages, totaling in 23500 paragraphs. WiLI is a classification dataset: Given an unknown paragraph written in one dominant language, it has to be decided which language it is.
reputation: WiLI-2018 is a widely used standard benchmark for language identification and is commonly cited in multilingual text classification work.
notes: A relatively saturated classification benchmark; short Wikipedia paragraphs can make some languages easier than others.
